label: PF Backlog 174
title: Runtime agent instruction overlays (append/replace per agent, no code/card edit)
body: core/prompt_overlays.py + products/<project>/agent-overlays.json (+ optional config/agent-overlays.json). set_overlay/clear_overlay/for_agent; '*' applies to all agents. Injected into the prompt by agent_runner _build_agent_prompt after base instructions; changes the prompt -> prompt-cache key (no stale hits). Lets you add detail to ANY existing or new agent at runtime. Verified E2E: a 'design' overlay appears in its prompt. compileall=0, wired_audit=0.

dashboard_impact.reason: Needs an agents-window UI to edit overlays and run incremental/amend (dashboard item).
